package rulefixtures

// scenario for create_and_update_share_same_dto_despite_conflicting_requiredness: A single DTO reused for create and update when validation rules clearly differ.
// fixture polarity: positive; family: architecture; severity: info.

type UserDTO struct {
	ID       string `json:"id,omitempty"`
	Email    string `json:"email"`
	Name     string `json:"name"`
	Password string `json:"password,omitempty"`
}

func CreateUser(dto UserDTO) error {
	if dto.Email == "" || dto.Name == "" || dto.Password == "" {
		return fmt.Errorf("create: email, name, and password are required")
	}
	return nil
}

func UpdateUser(dto UserDTO) error {
	if dto.ID == "" {
		return fmt.Errorf("update: id is required")
	}
	return nil
}
